title: Parallel sorting and CUDA image kernels
highlights: Merge sort: chunked sorting and merging across pthreads, with mutex-guarded work distribution, checked against a reference sort.
Radial brightening: three CUDA kernels compared on speed — float maths, integer shift, and shared-memory precomputed multipliers.
Image toolkit on BMP and PNG: overlay/blend at a position, red-dominance region detection and bounding-box extraction.
summary: Three course projects from GPU architecture and programming: a pthread merge sort, CUDA brightening kernels compared on speed, and a CUDA image toolkit.
